SOME LIMITATIONS ON LAND COMMODIFICATION MAKE SENSE TO PREVENT MONOPOLIZATION AND PRESERVE ACCESS, THOUGH I WOULDN'T REJECT ALL PROPERTY RIGHTS IN LAND.

THIS VIEW IGNORES HOW CORPORATIONS DEPEND ON PUBLIC GOODS, SOCIAL STABILITY, AND NATURAL RESOURCES, MAKING SOME SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY BOTH ETHICALLY NECESSARY AND PRACTICALLY WISE.

DECEPTION IN COMMERCE HARMS CONSUMERS AND UNDERMINES MARKET FUNCTION, SO GOVERNMENT ENFORCEMENT AGAINST MISLEADING CLAIMS IS JUSTIFIED AND IMPORTANT.
GENUINE MARKETS REQUIRE RULES AGAINST MONOPOLISTIC PRACTICES, SO THIS ISN'T ANTI-MARKET BUT RATHER A PREREQUISITE FOR MARKETS TO FUNCTION AS THEORY SUGGESTS.

REFLEXIVE QUESTIONING OF AUTHORITY IS HEALTHIER THAN REFLEXIVE OBEDIENCE, THOUGH THIS DOESN'T MEAN ALL AUTHORITY IS EQUALLY QUESTIONABLE OR THAT EVERY CHALLENGE IS EQUALLY WARRANTED.
RETRIBUTIVE JUSTICE HAS INTUITIVE APPEAL BUT OFTEN PERPETUATES CYCLES OF HARM; I FAVOR JUSTICE SYSTEMS ORIENTED TOWARD ACCOUNTABILITY, REPAIR, AND PREVENTING FUTURE HARM.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR ARTS AND CULTURAL INSTITUTIONS SERVES IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS BEYOND COMMERCIAL VIABILITY, INCLUDING ACCESS FOR THOSE WHO COULDN'T OTHERWISE AFFORD IT.

SOME PRIVACY FROM PARENTS IS DEVELOPMENTALLY HEALTHY AND APPROPRIATE AS CHILDREN MATURE, THOUGH THIS DOESN'T MEAN ALL SECRETS ARE EQUALLY ACCEPTABLE.
MARIJUANA CRIMINALIZATION HAS CAUSED ENORMOUS HARMS THROUGH INCARCERATION AND ENFORCEMENT DISPARITIES, SO DECRIMINALIZATION IS JUSTIFIED ON BOTH PRAGMATIC AND JUSTICE GROUNDS.

SOME PEOPLE FACE BARRIERS TO WORK THAT AREN'T SIMPLY UNWILLINGNESS, AND SURVIVAL NEEDS SHOULDN'T BE CONDITIONAL ON EMPLOYMENT, BUT I RECOGNIZE LEGITIMATE QUESTIONS ABOUT INCENTIVE STRUCTURES.
